description: Credentials, collection sync and field mapping of the ERP / external system integration (credtech#367, ADR 0007). Only admins.

fields.label: ERP
fields.options:
WBA
Smart Securities
Generic REST
QI Tech
fields.description: Your company's back-office ERP. CredTech only connects; the ERP contract stays between you and the vendor.

fields.label: WBA API User
fields.description: A WBA user with the API_CADASTRO and API_CONSULTA_OPERACAO profiles (FINANCEIRO to read settlements).

fields.label: Generic REST
fields.description: Any system with a REST/JSON API (ADR 0007). The configuration says the address, the authentication, the endpoints, the pagination and where each field is; secrets go in the table below and are referenced as {secret:NAME}.

fields.label: REST configuration
fields.description: JSON. Only https; private and internal addresses are blocked. Never put a password or token here: use {secret:NAME}.

fields.label: REST secrets
fields.description: Name + value (encrypted). Referenced in the configuration as {secret:NAME}.

fields.label: QI Tech
fields.description: QI Tech (QI DTVM) API: cedente registration and the cedente registry. QI Tech has no REST listing of títulos, so the collection sync stays off for it.

fields.label: QI Tech API URL
fields.description: The host of the profile your API key was issued for, e.g. https://assignor-api.qidtvm.com.br, https://consultant-api.qidtvm.com.br or https://manager-api.qidtvm.com.br (sandbox: .sandbox.qidtvm.com.br)

fields.label: QI Tech private key (PEM)
fields.description: The private.key whose public key was sent to QI Tech (never the .pub). Stored encrypted.

fields.label: Days after due date to start collection
fields.description: A título enters the Collection funnel this many days after its due date (D+1 by default).

fields.label: Settlement look-back (days)
fields.description: Each run reads settlements since the last successful run minus these days, to catch back-dated entries.

fields.label: Settlements read up to
fields.description: Moves forward only when a run finishes without errors.

fields.label: Cedente registration (credit funnel)
fields.description: Registers the card's company as a cedente in the ERP with the data enriched by the Receita. Only the credit funnel: collection cedentes are already in the ERP.

fields.label: Register cedentes in the ERP
fields.description: Off by default. Each attempt leaves a note on the card and on the company: registered (with the manager), already registered, missing data or refused by the ERP.

fields.label: When
fields.options:
Card enters a stage
Manual only

fields.label: Funnel
fields.description: The credit funnel. Empty: the credit funnel of the credit settings.

fields.label: Stage
fields.description: A card that enters this stage sends its company to the ERP.

fields.label: Default manager (Smart Securities)
fields.description: Name of the Smart manager used when the card owner is not one. As written in the Smart.

fields.label: Sector by CNAE division (optional)
fields.description: Only to override the automatic sector, one per line: 62 = Serviço de TI. Without it the sector comes from the CNAE, by the Smart's sector names.

fields.label: Cedente field mapping
fields.description: How CRM fields fill the ERP's cedente registration. Rows marked Required must be filled before sending.

fields.label: Título field mapping
fields.description: Which título field receives each column of the ERP's open títulos. ID, due date, sacado and cedente are always read.

fields.label: Sacado field mapping
fields.description: Which field of a NEW sacado (company or person) receives each column of the ERP's sacado registry. Read once, when the sync creates the sacado; empty fields only.

fields.label: Cedente registry mapping
fields.description: Which field of a NEW cedente (company) or its contact receives each column of the ERP's cedente registry. Read once, when the sync creates the cedente; empty fields only.

fields.label: Columns seen in the ERP
fields.description: JSON {"title": [...], "sacado": [...]}: every column the ERP returned, offered in the mapping screen.

fields.label: Registries to read again
fields.description: JSON: new cedentes/sacados whose ERP registry could not be read yet (tried again on the next runs).

fields.label: Simulation mode (nothing is saved)
fields.description: While on, each run only reports what it would create, update and close, and how long the ERP took; nothing is saved. Read the report below, then turn this off to run for real.

name: Cred Hub ERP Settings
